fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on proposals to divide Florida and on state politics, taxation, and legislative issues; discussion of law enforcement and prohibition raids; coverage of railroad rate reductions and their implications for Miami and South Florida development; local civic and charitable activity (Community Chest and a fundraising rummage sale for the Capitol Day Nursery); real estate market concerns including foreclosures and contract cancellations; sports coverage and boxing promotion notes; and recurring humor/columns and letters to the editor. Masthead lists publication and office information for Miami and Miami Beach.
